:::{#exm-closed-form-expression}
#### The quadratic formula

For $a \neq 0$ with $b^2 - 4 a c \ge 0$,
the roots of $a x^2 + b x + c = 0$ are

$$
x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4 a c}}{2 a},
$$

where the right-hand side is a [closed-form expression](#def-closed-form-expression) in $a$, $b$, and $c$.
By contrast, no closed-form expression is known for the root of $x - \cos x = 0$.

:::
